newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES FIRMER ON U.S. UNIT.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES FIRMER ON U.S. UNIT.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended Friday firmer on the key U.S. currency, buoyed by unexpected export inflows after depreciating in the morning under import pressure, dealers said.
"We had some unexpected U.S. dollar inflows and the Zimbabwe dollar firmed a little," one dealer said.
"But this is likely to be temporary. Come next week and import pressure will definitely still be there," he added.
Dealers have predicted a downward trend in the Zimbabwe dollar in coming weeks as loan repayments for the third quarter of the year are made.
The local unit finished Friday's session at 10.3250/3450 against the U.S. dollar, up from 10.3300/3500 the previous day.

On the crosses, it also edged up on sterling to 16.1250/1660 from 16.1300/1700 but eased to 6.7830/7960 against the mark from Thursday's 6.7920/8040. Against the rand it closed unchanged at 2.2770/2830.
